coordinate_system: u,v in [0,1] over the square ship sprite, origin top-left, nose up (-v), stern down (+v)
angle_convention: degrees, positive = clockwise on screen (same as canvas ctx.rotate); 0 = pointing up / forward (turrets)

parts.name: tendril0_R
parts.note: angle_0=rest; angle_i=angle_{i-1}+amp_i*sin(2pi*t+phase_i); segment i drawn rotated by angle_i around its pivot at joint_i; joint_{i+1}=joint_i+rotate((0,length_i),angle_i). 0deg = hanging straight down (towards stern).
